lines.t: Soft light on the bedroom walls
Two hearts running on their own flaws
You hold me like you're holding back the fall
I love you just to feel at all
I built my worth on your eyes
You built your hope on my smile
We kept our cracks just out of sight
Trading comfort for denial
But every unneeded shook like glass
Every promise cut too fast
We were breaking just to stand
Bleeding love from empty hands
We were holding on to being strong
Dying slow in our own arms
Love was hunger dressed as home
Two lost hearts trying not to drown
Now we're falling on the rock alone
All our pride and strife enthroned
Let the ruins be the place we learn
We were made for more than our control
I wore my past like armor plates
You wore your fear like quiet chains
We sat forever through our teeth
Still afraid to let them underneath
Every fight was proof of fear
Every silence screaming near
We were idols to ourselves
Praying to a love that couldn't help
We were holding on to being strong
Dying slow in our own arms
Love was hunger dressed as home to lost hearts trying not to drown
Now we're breaking on the cornerstone, all our self-reliance gone
Let the dust become the place he writes, why we're here and who we really are
On this stone our egos shatter, all our eye can do is die
On this hill our titles scatter, only naked hearts and eyes
I confess I can't be your savior, can't be my own anymore
I admit I was never the healer, I was just guarding every scar
Take our ruins, take our hands
We were never meant to stand on anything but you
We're not holding on to being strong
We're collapsing into love
Every burden, every wrong
Lay down at the feet above
Now this river running through our chest
Is it needed?
Sad, let's rest
We were made to love
Receive the flood
Vessels open, finally undone
Now I see you as a gift
Not the ground beneath my feet
I'm not your God, you're not my breath
We both bow to the one who is
Every day we learn again
To let go of mine and mine to mend
To be small and to be held
To be broken, to be failed
We're not holding on to being strong
We're held together from above
Healed and humbled on the rock
Overflowing with his love
Every heartbeat now agrees, we were born for this release
You and I on bended knees, living proof that love's the reason
We exist and breathe
On this stone we lay it down
All our self-made hollow crowns
You and I, just scars and grace
As His love pours through this place
Through this place
